laws.rule: Upper Dolpo (Charka Tangsong, Shey Phoksundo wards 1 to 7, Dolpo Buddha wards 4 to 6) needs a restricted area permit costing USD 500 a person for the first 10 days (about A$710, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), then USD 50 a day. Humla (Simikot, Namkha, Changkheli) and Lower Dolpo also need permits at lower weekly rates. Restricted areas are closed to free individual trekkers: the Department of Immigration issues the permit only through a licensed agency, for a group, and not beyond your visa's expiry. Fees are quoted in US dollars and paid in Nepali rupees.
